notes.note: Reviewed MemberProjectPage after the tool-library merge. The draft delta only renders shared Task status through taskStatusLabel and StatusBadge; member Project identity, scoped shared-work queries, selection and the incoming Agents and tools controls retain the captured requestScope. ProjectAgentsPanel remains behind manage-members and receives the same Station API base and request authority through ToolLibraryClientContext. The Agent/SDK scope guidance remains accurate; this bounded source review makes no new provider or browser acceptance claim.
